definitions.explanation: A wall built from precast concrete blocks, commonly used around houses and properties in Japan. Frequently discussed as an earthquake hazard because poorly reinforced walls can collapse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ブロック{塀|べい}だ。
examples.english: The house is surrounded by a concrete block wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧ブロック{塀|べい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk that the old block wall will collapse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒壊|とうかい}→倒壊：25308_toukai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ブロック{塀|べい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Accidents involving collapsed block walls during the earthquake occurred in various places.

notes:
Compound of ⟦ブロック→ブロック：05902_burokku⟧ (block) + {塀|べい} (wall, fence). Very common around Japanese residential properties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブロック{塀|べい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: build a block wall
- ブロック{塀|べい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: a block wall falls over
- ブロック{塀|べい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{倒壊|とうかい}→倒壊：25308_toukai⟧: collapse of a block wall
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧ブロック{塀|べい}: old block wall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{石塀|いしべい}→石塀：28374_ishibei⟧: stone wall — built with stones rather than concrete blocks
- ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧: wall — interior or structural wall of a building
- ⟦フェンス→フェンス：26996_fensu⟧: fence — metal or wire fencing, not solid
